topic: How to save water at home
script:
Every drop counts, because the water we have is limited.
First, turn off the tap while you brush your teeth.
Second, fix leaking taps and pipes, since a small drip wastes a lot of water over time.
Third, take shorter showers instead of long baths.
Fourth, run the washing machine only with a full load.
Fifth, collect rainwater and reuse it for plants.
Small habits, practised every day, add up to a big difference.
